mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order (order_no, user_id, train_id, train_no_snapshot, train_type_snapshot, from_station_snapshot, to_station_snapshot, depart_time_snapshot, arrive_time_snapshot, seat_id, seat_type, carriage_no, seat_no, passenger_name, id_card, price, status, depart_date, create_time, expire_time, origin_depart_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{trainId}, #{trainNoSnapshot}, #{trainTypeSnapshot}, #{fromStationSnapshot}, #{toStationSnapshot}, #{departTimeSnapshot}, #{arriveTimeSnapshot}, #{seatId}, #{seatType}, #{carriageNo}, #{seatNo}, #{passengerName}, #{idCard}, #{price}, #{status}, #{departDate}, NOW(), #{expireTime}, #{originDepartTime}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_no AS orderNo, o.train_id AS trainId, o.depart_date AS departDate, t.train_no AS trainNo, t.depart_time AS departTime, t.arrive_time AS arriveTime, t.from_station_name AS fromStationName, t.to_station_name AS toStationName FROM t_order o JOIN t_train t ON t.id = o.train_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status IN (0, 1) AND o.train_id <> #{excludeTrainId} AND TIMESTAMP(COALESCE(o.depart_date, t.depart_date), t.depart_time) < #{end} AND DATE_ADD(TIMESTAMP(COALESCE(o.depart_date, t.depart_date), t.arrive_time), INTERVAL IF(t.arrive_time <= t.depart_time, 1, 0) DAY) > #{start} ORDER BY o.depart_date LIMIT 5
